title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Nora Chen
ci_status: pass (flaky integration tests fixed on rerun)
description:
Motivation: Add a small set of opinionated RAG templates and agent/tool-calling quickstarts to help developers get started with common patterns (customer support, finance summarizer, email assistant). Also update docs site with a new quickstart guide and small UX/asset improvements. This PR bundles examples and docs changes so the quickstart links in the docs point to working examples and runnable code.

What changed: - new templates under redwood-examples/rag/templates (email_assistant.yaml, customer_support.yaml, finance_summary.yaml) - agent tool-calling examples in redwood-examples/agents/tool-calling for Python and TypeScript - quickstart guide in redwood-docs/docs/quickstarts/agents-tool-calling.md with step-by-step instructions and minimal config snippets - updated docs landing page to add RAG/agent quickstart card and linked assets - small image and diagram assets added to redwood-docs/static/img - basic Makefile and run scripts for examples to support local execution and CI smoke tests

Checklist: - [x] Add runnable examples with minimal dependencies - [x] Docs quickstart with copy-paste snippets - [x] CI smoke tests that run the Python example against a local mock server - [x] Link checks in docs updated - [x] Reviewers approved

Testing: Local smoke runs and CI integration (initially failed due to a flaky network test; fixed by switching to local mock and retry logic). Manual walkthrough performed by reviewer Miguel.

Follow-ups: - Add TypeScript smoke CI job to coverage matrix (tracked in ENG-4839) - Expand templates to include a serverless deploy example - Add telemetry examples and eval prompts for quality tracking

Notes: Kept templates intentionally minimal and opinionated to reduce onboarding friction. Examples contain environment variable placeholders and a short README describing required API keys and model compatibility.
